title: Size of leach pits

cell_spans.description: Printed leading header cell of the two header rows is blank; the stub column holds 'Dry Pits' and 'Wet Pits'
Printed heading '5 Users' spans the Dia and Depth(A) columns
Printed heading '10 Users' spans the Dia and Depth(A) columns
Printed heading '15 Users' spans the Dia and Depth(A) columns

notes: The printed header has two rows: the user-group row '5 Users', '10 Users', '15 Users' each spanning a Dia and a Depth(A) column, above the sub-header row 'Dia', 'Depth(A)', 'Dia', 'Depth(A)', 'Dia', 'Depth(A)'. The flattened header list prefixes each sub-header with its user group.
The stub header cell above 'Dry Pits'/'Wet Pits' is blank in the printed grid and is recorded as an empty string.
The sub-headers are printed as 'Depth(A)' with no space before the bracket; retained as printed.
'10 Users' is not hyphenated and '5 Users'/'15 Users' are printed with a space, as shown; retained.
Printed below the table: 'Note: (A)  Depth from bottom of pit to invert level of incoming pipe or drain (all dimensions in mm)'.
All dimensions are printed with thousands separators (e.g. '1,000', '1,100'); retained exactly as printed.
